verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance platform, so government ID document verification is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, monitoring and transaction screening. Nothing in the pack shows verification of passports, national IDs, driver licenses or residence permits, or a published list of supported countries and document types.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published
